helpSwap: s / swap                  Swap with right neighbour (dealer draws from stock)
helpRefuse: rf / refuse               Reveal a King and refuse the swap
helpNextRound: nr / nextround            Go to next round
promptTurnHelp: k / keep ... keep / s / swap ... swap with right neighbour (a King neighbour may refuse)
promptTurnHelpDealer: k / keep ... keep / s / swap ... draw a fresh card from the stock (dealer's privilege)
promptRefuseHelp: rf / refuse ... reveal King and refuse / ac / accept ... accept the swap
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... lowest-card players lose a life, then deal the next round
helpExampleKeep: k                         keep your card instead of swapping
